hero.why: 一個人開發的網頁版修圖軟體，介面接近 Photoshop，能直接開 PSD、XCF、Sketch 檔。獨立開發者的傳奇作品。
手繪質感的白板，打開就畫，支援多人協作和加密分享。很多開發者拿它畫系統架構草圖。
圖片壓縮器，所有運算都在瀏覽器裡完成，圖片不會上傳。裝成 PWA 後離線也能用，是示範 PWA 能做到什麼程度的代表作。
老牌圖表工具，圖形庫完整，檔案可以存在自己的雲端硬碟，不綁帳號。
手感非常順的無限畫布白板，箭頭會自動吸附形狀，適合腦力激盪和畫流程。
把 SVG 檔裡多餘的程式碼清掉，每個優化選項都能即時看到效果，做網頁圖示的常備工具。

apps.d: 西班牙各城市的即時花粉、空氣品質與紫外線指數，免註冊，適合過敏族
apps.e: Alergia España is a free web application providing real-time environmental health data for Spain. It offers daily updates on pollen levels, air quality (PM2.5, NO₂, O₃), and UV index by city. Users can consult data without registration, personalized for allergies and health profiles, and choose from a list of Spanish cities.

apps.d: 健身訓練紀錄本，記下每次訓練、追蹤體能進步
apps.e: Alzia is a personal progress tracker designed for physical activity and training. It offers a structured interface to log workouts and monitor fitness development. Users can record and organize their training sessions to review their journey. The application features customizable themes and a responsive design for various devices.

apps.d: 阿斯湯加瑜伽「月亮日」提醒，標出滿月與新月日方便安排練習
apps.e: A simple tracker for full and new moon days, aimed at Ashtanga yoga practitioners who traditionally rest from practice on moon days. The app shows when moon days fall so students can plan their practice week. Also handy for anyone who follows lunar cycles.

apps.d: 心情與人際關係反思日記，結合個人化星盤解讀
apps.e: Avenyora is a personal space for reflective insights, journaling, and saved readings. It helps users understand patterns shaping love, emotions, and decisions through personalized cosmic profiles. The app offers tools for grounded astrology, relationship insights, and AI-guided journaling, providing a continuous experience built around individual patterns.

apps.d: 無干擾的箱式呼吸練習，可自訂節奏與時長，幫助放鬆專注
apps.e: Boxbreathing is a free, distraction-free progressive web app designed for box breathing exercises. Users can set custom intervals and session lengths to practice this calming technique. It aims to reduce stress and improve focus without requiring an account or displaying ads.

apps.d: 777 段在裝置上即時生成的腦波聲音，用於專注、睡眠與放鬆
apps.e: Brainwavest provides 777 unique neuro-acoustic sessions designed for focus, sleep, calm, and creativity. Sessions are generated live on your device, avoiding streaming or loops, offering an evolving soundscape. Users can choose from various states and customize duration and listening preferences. Three complete sessions are available for free, with no credit card required.

apps.d: 新手爸媽育兒紀錄：餵奶、換尿布、用藥，兩人可共用一份紀錄
apps.e: Bundle of Joy helps parents track their baby's feeds, diapers, and medicine. It allows two people to share a record for one baby, running directly in the browser and installable to a home screen. The app also features growth tracking against WHO standards. It is free for two people and one baby and contains no ads.

apps.d: 貓咪食物安全查詢：查任何食物貓能不能吃，可離線使用
apps.e: Quick reference for cat owners — look up any food to see if it's safe for your cat. Offline-capable, no account needed. A simple but potentially life-saving PWA.

apps.d: 西班牙語正念冥想，短時引導課程，舒緩焦慮與改善睡眠
apps.e: Claridad offers guided meditation and mindfulness in Spanish, designed to help users manage anxiety, stress, and improve sleep. It features short, guided sessions, a clear path, and a workbook to integrate meditation into daily life. The platform provides over 100 guided sessions and a 3-month course.

apps.d: 極詳細的營養追蹤，記錄維生素、礦物質與胺基酸，營養師愛用
apps.e: Nutrient tracking with unusually detailed micronutrient data. Track vitamins, minerals, and amino acids — not just calories. Beloved by dietitians and biohackers for its accuracy.

apps.d: AI 日記夥伴，支援情緒追蹤與語音日記，幫你看見生活模式
apps.e: Dayora is an AI journaling companion designed for writing, reflection, and noticing patterns. It offers free AI-powered journaling with mood tracking, voice journaling, and daily AI insights for deeper self-understanding.

apps.d: 狗狗食物安全查詢：依獸醫準則判斷食物是否有毒，可離線
apps.e: Instant reference for dog owners — check if any food is safe or toxic for dogs. Works offline. Based on veterinary guidelines. Every dog owner should have this installed.

apps.d: 免費引導式冥想，從每日短練習到長時段靜坐都有
apps.e: DogeDharma Sit offers free guided meditation experiences for users seeking mindfulness and inner calm. It provides a variety of meditations, from short daily practices to longer sessions, designed to help individuals develop a consistent meditation habit. Users can track their progress with daily 'stamps'.

apps.d: 極簡習慣追蹤，連續天數一目了然，免帳號、資料只存在瀏覽器
apps.e: Minimalist habit tracker that works offline. Track daily habits with streaks, no account needed. All data lives in your browser. No ads, no gamification gimmicks.

apps.d: 戒滑手機小幫手：攔截打開社群 App 的動作，先停一下再決定
apps.e: A digital wellbeing tool for breaking the doomscrolling habit. Users create home screen shortcuts that intercept trips to social media apps, inserting a mindful pause and science-based friction before the feed opens. Aimed at anyone trying to reclaim focus and reduce compulsive scrolling on their phone.

apps.d: 每日蛋白質需求計算器，依減重、增肌等目標給出建議量
apps.e: The Dyadfit Protein Calculator helps individuals determine their daily protein needs for weight loss, strength training, and those on GLP-1 medication. It provides a personalized daily range and per-meal split, with calculations performed directly in the browser. The tool focuses on supporting muscle maintenance during weight loss.

apps.d: 安靜的呼吸與穩定練習空間，陪你在焦躁時慢下來
apps.e: Even Now is a calm companion designed to help users pause, breathe, and ground themselves. It offers a quiet, private space for reflection, guiding individuals through moments of mindfulness before responding to situations. The app focuses on promoting a sense of calm and self-awareness.

apps.d: 間歇性斷食計時器，內建 16:8、18:6、5:2 方案，離線可用
apps.e: Intermittent fasting timer with protocol presets (16:8, 18:6, 5:2). Track fasting windows, view history, get notifications. Offline-first PWA for fasting enthusiasts. The timer persists on the device across restarts, so a fast survives a closed tab or a rebooted phone.

apps.d: AI 營養追蹤，拍照辨識食物、記錄熱量與飲水，附餐點規劃
apps.e: NutriTrack is an AI-powered nutrition tracker that helps users log meals, calories, and water intake. It features AI food recognition from photos, a meal planner with fridge ingredients, and a recipe analyzer. The app also includes workout logging, a weight tracker, and weekly statistics, supporting multiple languages.

apps.d: AI 營養分析，用科學解釋拆解常見飲食迷思
apps.e: An AI-powered platform that analyzes nutrition information and debunks common diet myths using science-backed explanations. It aims to give users clarity about the calories and nutritional content of what they eat. Intended for people who want evidence-based guidance instead of fad-diet claims.

apps.d: 個人醫療檔案櫃，整理報告、檢驗與處方，資料存在本機
apps.e: Histmed is a personal clinical archive that helps users organize medical reports, analyses, and prescriptions on their device. It offers a local-first approach, storing data only on the user's device without requiring an account or cloud storage. It supports importing PDFs, ZIPs, and photos for easy access.

apps.d: 腸胃健康紀錄，用每日脹氣量表追蹤消化狀況，重視隱私
apps.e: Kakamit is a private Progressive Web App designed for tracking gut and bowel health. It offers a daily gas burden scale (DGBS) to help users monitor their digestive symptoms. This PWA provides a dedicated platform for personal health tracking, focusing on privacy and accessibility.

apps.d: 猜熱量小遊戲，訓練你對食物熱量與營養的直覺
apps.e: Kcaltrainer is a free Progressive Web App designed as a game to enhance your intuition for calories and nutritional values in food. It encourages estimating rather than precise counting, helping users develop a better understanding of food composition. The app is a web application accessible via any modern browser with JavaScript.

apps.d: 增肌訓練規劃與紀錄，安排課表並回顧進步
apps.e: Level Up is a Progressive Web App for hypertrophy training. It helps users plan workouts, log training sessions, and review their progress over time. The app focuses on evidence-informed principles and uses logged data to assist in making better training decisions for muscle growth.

apps.d: 開源冥想計時器，只做好一件事：替你計時靜坐
apps.e: Meditate is a free and open-source meditation timer delivered as a Progressive Web App. It focuses on a single job, timing your meditation sessions, without extra clutter. Suited to anyone building a regular mindfulness practice who wants a lightweight timer that runs in the browser.

apps.d: 完全免費的冥想 App，數百段引導冥想、助眠音樂與呼吸練習，開源無廣告
apps.e: Completely free meditation app — no subscriptions, no ads, no premium tier ever. Hundreds of guided meditations, sleep music, and breathing exercises. Open-source and offline.

apps.d: 瀏覽與轉換 DICOM 醫學影像（X 光、CT、MRI）
apps.e: A Progressive Web App for viewing and converting DICOM files, the standard format for medical images such as X-rays, CT, and MRI scans. Useful for healthcare professionals, students, or patients who need to open or convert medical imaging files directly in a browser.

apps.d: 免費心理健康資源，含情緒追蹤與自我評估工具
apps.e: MindWell offers free mental health support with evidence-based resources for anxiety, depression, and general mental wellness. It includes mood tracking, self-assessment quizzes, and a verified directory of emergency hotlines, primarily built for Bangladesh but accessible globally.

apps.d: 無限制斷食計時器，支援 16:8、一日一餐與長時間斷食
apps.e: MyFastingClock provides a free, unlimited fasting timer for intermittent and extended fasts. Users can track 16:8, OMAD, and open-ended fasting protocols without requiring signup or subscriptions. The app runs directly in the browser and saves fast progress on the device, offering a straightforward tool for managing fasting durations.

apps.d: AI 拍照算熱量，自動記錄三大營養素（葡萄牙文）
apps.e: Nutrion is a personalized food tracking app that uses AI to identify foods from photos, estimate calories, and log macronutrients. It helps users achieve their dietary goals through customized meal plans, activity tracking, and intelligent insights. The app is available in 11 languages.

apps.d: 癌症病友與照顧者的數位陪伴工具，來自羅馬尼亞
apps.e: OncoDots is a free digital companion for cancer patients and their caregivers, built in Romania. The app runs directly in the browser on any phone and supports the toughest weeks — the first 90 days after diagnosis: a public library of easy-to-understand guides, over 90 recipes adapted to treatment

apps.d: 德文隱私健康檔案，AES-256 加密存在本機，免雲端免帳號
apps.e: A privacy-focused, German-language health profile app that stores personal health records locally with AES-256 encryption, using no cloud services and requiring no account. Suitable for managing your own health data or keeping a care profile for a relative, with full data sovereignty.

apps.n: Ponoki - Calm Games for Busy Minds
apps.d: 一組療癒小遊戲，給忙碌焦躁的腦袋短暫休息
apps.e: Ponoki is a collection of tiny calm games for busy, restless minds. Play short, gentle games to take a break, reset, and feel a little lighter. Free to play, with no pressure, streaks, or punishment. Installs to your home screen from any modern browser — no app store, no download; its manifest declares standalone display with a 512px icon, and its service worker caches assets for offline use. Submitted by its author

apps.d: 給受他人成癮問題影響的成年人的支持工具，含日記與每日反思
apps.e: Quiet Sisters Recovery offers mobile online support for adults affected by another person’s addiction. It includes crisis tools, a guided workbook, daily reflections, boundaries, and private journaling for family and friends seeking support.

apps.d: 戒除習慣的個人工具與社群，按自己的步調前進
apps.e: Quit Engine offers personal quitting tools and a community to support individuals in making choices about quitting. It emphasizes a user's own pace and reasons, providing support to help manage cravings, such as for cigarettes. The platform is described as a free public-benefit project.

apps.d: 分手復原 App：個人化時間軸、每日打卡與引導日記
apps.e: Reorient is a breakup recovery app offering a personalized timeline, daily check-ins, and a guided journal. It provides tools for difficult moments and a no-contact counter, all built on published research. Designed to help users navigate a breakup day by day.

apps.d: 健身組數紀錄，記下每組次數與重量
apps.e: RepBuddy is a workout companion designed to help users track their daily exercise routines. It allows for logging multiple sets, reps, and weights for various workouts. The app also features AI coaching to support fitness journeys, making it suitable for individuals focused on structured physical training.

apps.d: 拍下體重計照片就自動記錄體重，AI 整理體重趨勢
apps.e: ScanMyScale offers effortless weight tracking by turning photos of any scale into a continuous, AI-powered weight history. It allows users to track trends, set goals, and celebrate milestones, whether they're at home, a hotel, or the gym. The app provides a personal weight history and trend analysis.

apps.d: 高爾夫短桿練習紀錄，專攻 100 碼以內的進步
apps.e: Scoring Zone is the ultimate practice app for golfers focused on mastering their short game. It helps users track progress and lower scores from 100 yards and in, offering specialized putting and chipping drills. Designed for golfers aiming to improve their performance around the green.

apps.d: AI 育兒顧問，提供個人化建議並記住對話脈絡
apps.e: Snugs.ai is an AI-powered parenting advisor providing personalized advice and baby monitoring. It offers chat memory for ongoing conversations and is designed to be a 24/7 expert resource for parents. Access new log entries, chat with AI, or view insights directly.

apps.d: 升降桌坐站提醒，切換時附 15 秒微運動
apps.e: Stint is a calm, minimal desk companion for sit/stand desks. It helps users manage long blocks of sitting or standing, with an optional ~15s micro-move when switching desk positions. Designed to encourage gentle desk rhythm, Stint is not a focus or Pomodoro timer, offering a simple approach to desk-based well-being.

apps.d: 拍餐點估算熱量，飲食、睡眠、活動與體重記在同一本日記
apps.e: TempoLife is a health tracker that estimates calories and macros from meal photos. It helps users log food, sleep, activity, and weight in one diary. The app connects with Google Health Connect and smartwatches to analyze heart rate, sleep, and movement with AI.

apps.d: 把 YouTube 健身影片剪成可追蹤的訓練課表
apps.e: TrainFlow helps users transform YouTube training videos into structured, trackable routines. It enables precise clipping of exercise timestamps, organization into custom workflows, and distraction-free training sessions on mobile. Ideal for athletes, coaches, and fitness enthusiasts to refine technique and track progress.

apps.d: 生理週期行事曆，並讓伴侶收到適時的貼心提示
apps.e: uniheart is a cycle calendar and partner hint app. It helps users understand their body with cycle phase and daily tips, and allows partners to offer timely support without seeing sensitive data. Data is stored on the device only, ensuring privacy. Users can log their period and feelings to improve forecast accuracy.

apps.d: 把每天走路的距離變成一趟虛擬旅程，沿著你選的路線前進
apps.e: A walking tracker that turns daily exercise into a virtual journey: log your walks and watch the accumulated distance advance along any route you choose, such as a trek across a country. The visual progress gives casual walkers an ongoing goal beyond simple step counts.

apps.d: 開源熱量與營養追蹤，大型食物資料庫、完全離線，MyFitnessPal 的免費替代
apps.e: Open-source calorie and nutrition tracker. Log meals from a large food database, track macros, set goals. No ads, no subscriptions, fully offline. The free MyFitnessPal alternative.

apps.d: 體重追蹤與目標日期預測，可同步 Garmin 與 Strava
apps.e: Weight Forecast helps users track their weight and estimate a goal-weight date. It supports food logging, syncing with Garmin and Strava for workouts and sleep, and offers a daily AI coach via Telegram. The app calculates BMI and provides progress charts, allowing users to see a linear trend of their weigh-ins.

apps.d: 依目標、器材與經驗量身打造的 12 週訓練計畫
apps.e: Wobuddy (WO Buddy) is a progressive web app offering a personalized twelve-week training plan. It tailors workouts based on your goals, schedule, equipment, experience, and limitations. Users can complete a questionnaire and view their first week for free, with Pro unlocking the full block and additional features.

apps.d: 開源健身課表規劃：選肌群與器材，附影片示範的動作
apps.e: The community-revived open-source workout planner — pick muscle groups and available equipment, get video-demonstrated exercises, build sessions and track progress, free forever. Ships a standalone PWA manifest with a five-icon set, so it installs to a phone home screen like a native gym companion app.

apps.d: AI 健身課表產生器，60 秒內依教練方法排出個人計畫
apps.e: WorkoutGen is a free AI-powered gym workout plan generator and tracker built on a state-certified coach's methodology. The app creates personalized workout plans in 60 seconds designed to help users build muscle, lose weight, and increase strength. It combines artificial intelligence with professional fitness coaching principles to deliver customized training programs that users can track and follow through a progres

apps.d: 電子木魚，可自動敲擊並播放心經等經文（簡體中文）
apps.e: An online electronic wooden fish (muyu) app for mindfulness practice, in Chinese. Tap once or enable automatic tapping, listen to chants such as the Heart Sutra and Green Tara mantra, and keep a daily practice record. Free and registration-free, it installs to the desktop and works offline.

apps.d: 伊斯蘭禮拜時間與喚拜提醒，附麥加朝向指示
apps.e: Adhaniya is a Progressive Web App designed for Islamic prayer times. It features an adhan alarm for each prayer, provides qibla direction, and offers multi-language support. The app includes a prayer times schedule and settings for personalized use, acting as a companion for daily prayers.

apps.d: 用你喜歡的 YouTube 影片或 MP3 當鬧鐘鈴聲
apps.e: Set alarms that wake you with a YouTube video or MP3 file of your choice. A unique browser-based alarm clock — no app download, works as a PWA. Never wake up to a default beep again.

apps.d: 匿名分享筆記，產生專屬網址，可設定閱後即焚
apps.e: Create an anonymous, shareable note with a unique URL. No account, no tracking — great for sharing temporary text or passwords. Notes can be set to self-destruct.

apps.d: 協助西班牙馬拉加尋求庇護者的支援工具
apps.e: An app built to support asylum seekers in Malaga, Spain, integrated with the EasyRights project. It offers a digital point of support for people navigating the asylum process, and is aimed at refugees, migrants, and the organisations that assist them during arrival and settlement in the region.

apps.d: 孟加拉曆，提供每日 tithi、星宿與曆法資訊
apps.e: A free Bengali (Bangla) calendar PWA offering daily tithi, nakshatra, and panchang calculated using the traditional Bishuddha Siddhanta method — the same reference published Bengali panjikas use. Includes auspicious muhurta timings, daily rashifal, 15-day weather forecasts, and a growing collection

apps.d: 在瀏覽器中顯示裝置電池狀態
apps.e: A small Progressive Web App that displays your device's battery status in the browser. It reads battery information from the web platform and gives users a quick view of their charge state, and it also serves as a lightweight example of what web apps can access.

apps.d: 八字排盤：輸入生辰算出四柱、天干地支
apps.e: The BaZi Calculator creates a Four Pillars chart from your birth details, including date, time, gender, and birthplace. It calculates Heavenly Stems, Earthly Branches, Ten Gods, Five Element balance, and Luck Pillars. Calculations run locally in your browser, requiring no sign-up or data transmission to a server.

apps.d: 注重隱私的 PDF 工具箱：合併、分割、壓縮、簽名，全程在本機處理
apps.e: A privacy-first PDF toolkit where every operation — merge, split, compress, rotate, sign, watermark, convert — runs entirely client-side with zero uploads and zero tracking. The standalone web manifest makes it installable from the browser, turning BentoPDF into a local PDF app that never phones home with your documents.

apps.n: BigRed.link | A big red URL shortener
apps.d: 大紅色的短網址產生器，把長網址變短好分享
apps.e: BigRed.link is a self-described big red URL shortener that converts long web addresses into short links that are easier to share. Comparable in purpose to services like Bitly or TinyURL, it suits anyone who needs compact links for messages, documents, or social posts. No additional features such as analytics are described in the available information.

apps.d: 開源密碼管理器，端對端加密保險庫、跨裝置同步，個人免費
apps.e: Open-source password manager — the best LastPass alternative. End-to-end encrypted vault, browser extension, cross-device sync. Free for personal use, self-hostable. Vaults stay readable offline once the app is installed, so a lost connection never locks you out of your own passwords.

apps.d: 瀏覽器中的藍牙傳輸中心，完全離線可用（葡萄牙文）
apps.e: A Bluetooth transfer hub for the browser, in Portuguese, that works fully offline. It centers on transfers between devices over Bluetooth and adds a public terminal, connection logs, and a large UUID reference for working with Bluetooth services. Useful for tinkerers exploring Bluetooth on the web.

apps.d: 批次編修圖片：一次縮放、裁切、轉檔、壓縮上百張，本機處理
apps.e: Bulk image editing in your browser — resize, crop, convert, compress hundreds of images at once. All processing is local, no server uploads. A massive time-saver for content creators.

apps.d: 科學、財務、日期與單位計算機大全，可離線使用
apps.e: Scientific, financial, date, and unit calculators in one place. Installable, works offline. Far more powerful than your phone's built-in calculator. Each calculator keeps its own history, so a mortgage figure is still there after switching to the unit converter and back.

apps.d: 注重隱私的精準時鐘，鬧鐘、全螢幕數字鐘與計時器
apps.e: Clock Master is a modern, privacy-first Progressive Web App engineered for high-precision timekeeping. Features background-reliable Web Audio alarms, a full-screen digital clock, Pomodoro timer with ambient soundscapes, meeting planner, and solar tracker—100% offline ready with zero tracking.

apps.d: 開源時鐘 App：計時器、碼錶與鬧鐘
apps.e: An open-source clock app for the browser that bundles a timer, stopwatch, and alarms, with customization options so you can make the app your own. It mirrors the core features of a phone's built-in clock in web form. Useful for anyone who wants timing tools in a browser, and open for developers to inspect.

apps.d: 單純的計數器，數次數、人數或庫存都好用
apps.e: A single-purpose counter application for tallying anything you need to count, such as repetitions, attendees, or inventory items. Built as a Progressive Web App, it deliberately does nothing beyond incrementing and tracking counts, making it useful for anyone wanting a no-frills tally counter.

apps.d: 輕量 CSV 檔案檢視與分析工具
apps.e: Lightweight viewer and analyzer for CSV files that runs in the browser. Useful for developers, analysts, and anyone who needs to quickly inspect spreadsheet-style data without launching Excel or Google Sheets, it focuses on fast viewing and basic analysis of comma-separated files.

apps.d: 免費開源畫圖工具：流程圖、網路圖、UML、平面圖，離線可用
apps.e: Free, open-source diagramming tool. Flowcharts, network diagrams, UML, floor plans. Works offline, saves to Google Drive/GitHub/local. Widely used in enterprises as a Visio alternative. Files stay in the .drawio XML format, so a diagram remains editable years later without the tool that made it.

apps.d: 英國屋主找在地認證師傅、免費取得報價
apps.e: Energy North connects homeowners with verified local tradespeople, offering free quotes for various jobs. Users can post their job free and receive direct contact from electricians, plumbers, gas engineers, and builders in their area. The platform aims to simplify finding local services.

apps.d: 以太坊網域名稱服務，替錢包與網站取好記的名字
apps.e: Decentralised naming for wallets, websites, & more. Installs to your home screen from any modern browser — no app store, no download, its manifest declares standalone display with a 512px icon, and it caches nothing for offline use, so it needs a connection.
